judge-football.justification: Usable (8.6): clear price decision (drop Break G from the price), a day-3 tiebreaker, named GO/HOLD receivers with dated film clips, pre-registered flip conditions and a Combine protocol change. Tiebreaker is only a lean (interval includes zero); thin 2026 evidence (4 names, 20 pairs, power 0.20-0.27) holds it below 9. Football context (8.5): opportunity via pick and routes, survivorship (33 of 149), Nacua exclusion, QB adjustment, rep noise, TE/WR split, slot share (shown, not tested). Scheme weakly handled (man/zone only a film item); 40-clip start offset not addressed here; in-vs-catches conversion rests on assumed constants. Unique (8.4): same-receiver drill-to-NFL route-family reframing, pre-registered hashed shortlist; headline is a null. Terminology (8.5): correct language; 'Break G' unit and 'inch of SOE' idiosyncratic; several conflicting numbers; awkward appendix sentences about 'an earlier brief' and late freeze.
top_changes: Make the day-3 recommendation decision-grade: one explicit rule with stated cost of being wrong (e.g. tiebreak only when pick gap is under N slots) and expected hit-rate change in plain terms; demote TE caveat to one line.

Strengthen scheme/alignment evidence: per-receiver table of SOE split by man vs zone and slot vs wide with cell n (cells under ~30 snaps unreliable); add 40-clip laser-offset caveat next to speed benchmark; reconcile 0.43, 0.74, 0.34 with one headline definition.

Tighten shortlist: lead with GO for Washington and Douglas, shrink HOLD names; show P 95% and 89% next to calibrated day-3 base rate (~40-54%); add 2026 decision date and what result flips each name; cut appendix machinery and 'earlier brief' sentences from body.

judge-datascience.spot_checks: reproduce_baseline.py matches numbers.json (naive recompute from baseline_inputs.csv did not match; column definitions opaque); check.py ok (1967 words, 4 figures, 4 tables); speed 0.43/0.74/0.34 all in numbers.json and appendix; binomial intervals 7/13, 8/20 not recomputed (scipy missing).
judge-datascience.justification: Strong honest null-result paper with sound validation: no-tracking baseline (log pick, 40, weight, NGS, TE flag) held-out R2 0.00 [-0.51,0.14]; ridge variant; Break G increment dR2 0.013 [-0.157,0.085]; unseen-class and season-pair folds; per-claim n; errors-in-variables for single-rep reliability; IPW, Nacua exclusion, QB adjustment; frozen hashed rule with power analysis. Innovation high. Weaknesses: day-3 tiebreaker on 20 pairs with interval including zero and not blind (0.63 vs 0.31 revision shows fragility); 2026 power 0.20-0.27; shuffle p=0.01 vs bootstrap interval not reconciled; baseline CSV not self-explanatory; 3,892-line analysis.py takes ~9 min; lower standardized speed benchmark could read as selective though disclosed.
top_changes: Resolve shuffle p=0.01 vs bootstrap interval including zero: receiver-clustered bootstrap or permutation test, one pre-specified p/interval, state effective independent n (20 pairs from 16 receivers).
Make verification easy: document baseline_inputs.csv columns and folds; ship a under-a-minute script recomputing headline dR2, slope and three speed rhos with numbers.json diff.

Add equivalence test (TOST) against +/-3 in margin; 90% interval [-3.6,+1.0] does not fit inside +/-3 so 'inside the margin' framing is inconsistent; or add Bayesian P(|effect|<3); apply shrinkage/fold logic to Break G increment leave-one-class-out.

judge-writeup.justification: check.py passes (1,967 words, 4 figures, 4 tables). Title states finding; lede defines Break G and SOE; finalist structure. Weaknesses: bold lede ~85 words with mixed units; body dense with analyst machinery (fold construction, retracted 0.63, shuffle p=0.01, leave-one-pair-out, film checklist game-clock detail); result sections sit after actions; headline recommendation a lean undercut by TE result (-0.50) and baseline R2 0.00; motivation terse ($1.08M, sixth-receiver spot, '60% signal, 40% noise' unexplained); 2026 rule frozen 24 Oct 2026 after season began weakens pre-registration.
top_changes: Rewrite bold lede to ~50 words in one unit, e.g. 'Combine cut sharpness (Break G) does not predict NFL separation over expected: -1.2 in per sd [-3.6,+1.0], 116 unseen receivers. Speed does carry. For day-3 ties, lean on last-season SOE.' Move catches conversion and +/-3 in margin to table row.

Move analyst machinery to appendix (rank-correlation gain paragraph with retracted 0.63, shuffle p, leave-one-pair-out, ridge baseline, reproduce_baseline.py); cut film checklist to short bullets; use ~250 freed words to explain $1.08M and '60% signal'.

Reconcile action 1 with evidence: lead with firm finding (stop pricing drill cut, run double rep); present SOE tiebreaker as labelled lean once with TE exclusion and 0.20 power inline; put result sections right after decision table; name 2 GO and 2 HOLD and say plainly the 2026 freeze came after season began.

judge-viz.justification: Four figures plus tables, within cap. Fig 1 hero tracking-native (99 receivers scatter with bootstrap band and rugs, five percentile receivers drill vs NFL traces). Fig 2 pooled band, power legend, 0.2 label, 40-speed reference. Fig 3 top vs bottom thirds with difference bands. Fig 4 20 pairs, leave-one-out, subgroup gains, hit rates, 2026 mini-cards. Weaknesses: 0.43/0.74/0.34 unreconciled in figures; Fig 4 tall and dense, panel A labels clip, panel B mislabelled p-value subtitle, cluttered shuffle shading; some text under 9 pt; Fig 1 mixes two messages; Fig 3 partly repeats Fig 1B and Fig 2; Fig 4 cards are text boxes.
judge-viz.per_figure: fig1_cards keep; fig2_chain keep; fig3_film keep (candidate to merge to appendix); fig4_shortlist keep (split, title should say WR only)
top_changes: Split Fig 4: dumbbell + subgroup forest for day-3 tiebreaker, 2026 calls as separate strip with dot-and-interval cards; fix clipped labels; p=0.01 in caption.
Reconcile speed benchmark across Fig 1 subtitle, Fig 2 and text: show in-cut 0.34/0.43 and full-play 0.74 (n=100) as two labelled bands; raise text to at least 11 pt.
Make Fig 1 carry one message; move or merge Fig 3 to appendix and spend slot on drill-vs-game path map Boutte vs Washington.
